{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kas'as Chen'ru Den''' was a legendary [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] arren that was known to most beings as the Gray Cove Den. Millennia before the [[Corellian Crisis]], this den was destroyed when its outer wall suddenly collapsed. Within minutes, it was filled with silt and mud that buried the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]] occupiers alive. Legends would speak of valuable artifacts and relics buried within the den which led to the [[Sacorrian Triad]] attempting to excavate the site in order to recover the valuables for themselves. The Triad would be thwarted by a group of freelance explorers that managed to hold the [[Sacorria]]ns long enough for the den to be declared a sanctuary.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
